description: Skull-strip a brain image of any contrast or resolution with FreeSurfer's mri_synthstrip (SynthStrip, PyTorch on CPU) from a local FreeSurfer install (tested with dev 2024-03-27). Writes the brain-only image and a binary brain mask, both on the input grid.

brain.description: Input image with everything outside the brain zeroed.

brain_mask.description: Binary brain mask on the input grid.

requirements: FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27) (mri_synthstrip); FREESURFER_HOME is set from the executable found
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs mri_synthstrip -i <t1> -o brain.nii.gz -m brain_mask.nii.gz -b <border> -t <threads> through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: Install FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27) (https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/DownloadAndInstall), or set FREESURFER_SYNTHSTRIP to its bin/mri_synthstrip.

useWhen: Skull-strip a brain image of any contrast with FreeSurfer's SynthStrip on a machine that has FreeSurfer installed.
A next step needs a brain mask on the input grid, e.g. the brain-mask volume in label-volumes.

avoidWhen.when: FreeSurfer is not installed but the brainchop CLI is.
FreeSurfer is not installed but the Neurodesk Webapps suite is.

preconditions: FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27) under /Applications/freesurfer or /usr/local/freesurfer, on PATH, or via FREESURFER_SYNTHSTRIP.
effects: Writes brain.nii.gz and brain_mask.nii.gz to the output directory, both on the input grid.

failures.meaning: No FreeSurfer install with mri_synthstrip was found.
failures.remedy: Install FreeSurfer 7.4 or a newer dev build (tested with dev 2024-03-27), or set FREESURFER_SYNTHSTRIP to its bin/mri_synthstrip.
Read the step log, and check that t1 is a readable image with neuroflow_inspect.

duration.basis: One gallery run on an Apple-silicon Mac (FreeSurfer dev 2024-03-27, 8 threads, 1 mm T1, running beside SynthSeg): 177 s.
